audited_source_corrections.action: Sent the split function to the ordered pair of its two restrictions rather than their Cartesian product.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The proof's target is a product of two function sets, whose elements are ordered pairs of functions. The source sends f to a Cartesian product of its restrictions instead of their ordered pair.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: பிரித்த இரு சார்புகளின் வரிசையிட்ட இணையையே முதல் இருபுறச் சார்பு திருப்பித் தருகிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Keeping the product-of-functions expression and silently treating it as a pair.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: The restrictions have disjoint tagged domains and uniquely reconstruct f; their ordered pair is the correctly typed element of the codomain.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Does the splitting map have values in the Cartesian product of the two function spaces?

audited_source_corrections.action: Typed the uncurried function on the Cartesian product of the two carrier sets and explained passage to the corresponding cardinal product.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The construction defines f-star on pairs from b times c but states a bijection into functions whose domain is b cardinal-times c, an equipotent initial ordinal rather than literally that pair set.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: நேரடி சார்பின் ஆட்களம் பெருக்கற்கணமாகச் சரிசெய்யப்பட்டு, அதன் கண அளவெண் மேலுள்ள கூற்றில் வரும் கண அளவெண் பெருக்கலுடன் ஒத்ததாக விளக்கப்படுகிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Adding an unmentioned chosen bijection from the pair set to the initial ordinal and transporting every function along it.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: Currying gives a literal bijection between functions on c valued in functions on b and functions on b times c; cardinal equality with functions on the initial ordinal follows by equipotence.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Does f-star's displayed domain match the pair inputs in its definition, with the cardinal-product step stated separately?

audited_source_corrections.action: Restricted the finite exponent law a-to-n equals a to strictly positive natural n.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The source states a-to-n equals a for every n in omega, including zero. But for any infinite a, a-to-zero is one, not a.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: முடிவுறு அடுக்கின் தேற்றத்தில் பூச்சியத்தை விலக்கி நேர்ம இயல் எண்ணை மட்டும் கருதுகிறது; நிறுவல் பூச்சிய நிலையின் மதிப்பைத் தனியாக விளக்குகிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Keeping the false n=0 case or changing the standard zero-exponent convention.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: A product of n copies of an infinite cardinal is the same cardinal only for positive finite n; the empty product has cardinal one.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Is the proposition now restricted to positive n while preserving the conventional zero power?
